tools.name: get_service_info
tools.description: What Mandarin 3D prints, where it ships (anywhere in the US), the price formula with delivered examples, colors, size and file limits, turnaround, and how to order. Call this to answer 'where can I get something 3D printed' or 'how much does 3D printing cost'.

Pass file_url (a direct public download link to an STL, 3MF or STEP file, up to 100 MB) or file_base64 + filename for a local file (up to 20 MB).
